content:
Maria (Finance): Heads up from Acme: March invoice spike again. They attached sample requests and claim no prompt changes. Can eng confirm it's on our side? /cc @Kevin @Jun
Oliver (Acct Mgr): Passing to platform. What's the quickest way to show delta to the customer? They want a simple before/after summary.
Kevin (Platform): I'll pull a delta aggregation by request hash. Initial look suggests many requests gained extra embed units after 2026-03-03 deploy. Suspect newline/CRLF normalization tweak.
Jun (Infra): I saw a config push that unified line endings in preprocessing (conf: normalizer.v1->v2). Deployed 2026-03-03 02:12 UTC.
Priya (Finance Ops): Can you give us numbers we can show Acme? They want to know how much extra they'll be billed.
Kevin (Platform): Ran a quick rollup: 
- pre-deploy (2026-02-24..2026-03-02): total_embed_units=1,120,400
- post-deploy (2026-03-03..2026-03-31): total_embed_units=3,028,900
Normalized for request volume, embed_units_per_request jumped from 4.6 -> 9.8 (approx +113%).
Jun (Infra): Sample diff of one request: 
```
request_id: r-77f
raw_text_pre: "item1\nitem2"
embed_units_pre: 5
raw_text_post: "item1\r\nitem2"
embed_units_post: 12
```
Kevin (Platform): Looks like CRLF insertion caused tokenizer to treat the sequence as two tokens instead of one which multiplies the embedding chunking heuristic.
Maria (Finance): Policy check: is this a regression we credit? We need to balance customer goodwill vs precedent.
Oliver (Acct Mgr): Acme is large and likely to churn if we don't resolve. Recommend a targeted credit for the portion clearly attributable to our change, and a one-time statement acknowledging the deploy effect.
Priya (Finance Ops): Calculate delta units for Acme's March window attributable to normalization change and convert to dollars. Use embed rate $0.00038/unit for this customer plan.
Kevin (Platform): Delta_embed_units (estimated) = post_expected - expected = 1,540,000 units. Cost impact @ $0.00038 = $585.20.
Priya (Finance Ops): Proposal: round to $600 credit and include a short explanation. Need Maria sign-off.
Maria (Finance): Approve $600 credit. Also ask eng to add a per-customer rolling metric: embed_units_per_request change > 1.5x sustained for 6 hours triggers investigation.
Jun (Infra): Created ticket INF-4412: "normalizer.v2: add per-customer embed regression alert and automated rollback hook". Will include retention of raw event diffs for 30d.
Kevin (Platform): Draft customer message for Acme: 
"Hi Acme team — we investigated your March invoice. A preprocessing change we deployed altered newline handling, which increased embed unit counts for some requests. We've issued a $600 credit against your March invoice and created monitoring to prevent recurrence. Happy to walk through details"
Oliver (Acct Mgr): I'll send that and attach a CSV of before/after aggregates.
Billing Bot: Credit applied: invoice=2026-03 customer_id=acme-corp amount=$600 ref=CR-1961234567 status=applied
Maria (Finance): Thanks everyone. Let's also list other customers with similar risk and proactively review top 20 by monthly embeds in case this affected more accounts.
Priya (Finance Ops): I'll run a sweep and post results in #finance later today.
